details.name: Liino
details.quote: Endmin, missed me? As the brightest and cutest super idol of Talos-II, is there any special treatment for me? No...? Aw, you are still so blunt and direct, and yet somehow, still endearing... Guess it can't be helped.
details.infection: Oripathy positive, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Epiphany: Improvised Performance Whenever and wherever! When she wants to perform, anything beneath her feet becomes her special stage.
details.exp2d: Street Wisdom: Idol-Tier Negotiation She can get zealous fans to quiet down and make annoyingly invasive reporters speechless. And she can do these without using her Djall Arts.
details.hb1d: Creative: Soap Opera Appreciation "A character introduced in episode 1 ... is still around in episode 325... Is this the main lead? How enviable!"
details.hb2d: Fine Arts: Old Vinyl Collection Nostalgia is not a bad habit. It is her wish. Maybe a day will come when her albums will become a treasured piece of someone's collection.
